delete.title: Remove the vehicle
delete.description: The vehicle becomes Inactive and leaves the list. Its data is kept.

form.vinHelp: Exactly 17 characters, as stamped on the chassis.
form.acquiredAtHelp: The day the vehicle was handed to its owner; empty means today.
form.ownerHelp: The organization that owns the vehicle; empty means the current organization.
form.statusReasonHelp: Required when the status changes; kept in the change history.
form.statusReasonRequired: Please give a reason for the status change.
